text: Weighted least squares regression depends on estimated weights, and contrary to the theory behind the method the exact weights are almost never determinable in real applications such as this study.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Impact of Dodd-Frank Act Compliance Cost on the Hedge Fund Industry (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389423

isBasedOn.name: The Impact of Dodd-Frank Act Compliance Cost on the Hedge Fund Industry

abstract: A downside of weighted LSLR methodology is its dependence on estimated weights. Contrary to the theory behind weighted LSLR methodology, in real applications, such as the application in this study, the exact weights are almost never exactly determinable.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: real world applications of weighted least squares regression
